result.summary: A narrow residential street with row houses and on-street parking. While the narrow geometry likely keeps vehicle speeds low, the pedestrian environment is constrained by narrow sidewalks and a lack of formal crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Narrow sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks are narrow, making it difficult for pedestrians to pass each other or for those using mobility aids.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of drivers.

hazards.name: Poor pavement quality
hazards.description: Cracks and patches in the roadway surface could pose a trip hazard for pedestrians crossing mid-block.

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalks to improve accessibility and pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and patched asphalt to provide a smoother and safer surface for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, historic residential alley with mature trees and brick sidewalks. The environment is inherently low-speed due to its scale, but it lacks formal pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps.

hazards.name: Uneven Walking Surface
hazards.description: Uneven brickwork and fallen leaves create a potential trip or slip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and along the alleyway.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the transition from sidewalk to street difficult for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the alley and the foreground street.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with tactile warning strips to improve accessibility at the intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair and level the brick sidewalk and implement regular leaf clearing to eliminate trip hazards.

result.summary: This is a narrow, one-way residential street with sidewalks on both sides and mature street trees. While the narrow roadway geometry naturally encourages lower vehicle speeds, the environment lacks formal pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right side of the street can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Slippery Debris
hazards.description: Significant accumulation of leaves in the gutter and on the sidewalk can become slippery when wet, posing a fall risk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the gutters and sidewalk edges

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the end of the block to improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings at intersections to formalize pedestrian priority and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at corners to ensure the street is accessible to people with mobility aids or strollers.

result.summary: The image shows a very narrow one-way residential street with narrow sidewalks on both sides. While the narrow geometry naturally limits vehicle speeds, the pedestrian space is constrained by mature trees and signage poles.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks are extremely narrow, particularly where trees and signposts are located, which may force pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the narrow street

hazards.name: Slipping Hazard
hazards.description: Significant accumulation of wet leaves on the sidewalk and roadway surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the length of the street

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The mature tree and the building's curved facade create blind spots for pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the tree and left side at the building corner

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Conversion
interventions.description: Given the narrow width, convert the street into a shared space with level surfaces to prioritize pedestrian movement and formalize low vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lower-height lighting fixtures to improve visibility within the narrow corridor at night.

interventions.title: Regular Debris Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement more frequent street and sidewalk cleaning to remove leaves and litter that create slipping hazards.
